source: Aalborg accepted manuscript, printed pp. 2–4, Fig. 2, Table I and Figs. 3, 5–6
base_convention: Use S_b = P_ref,W/P_ref,pu, V_b as the Table I dq phase-peak voltage, I_b=S_b/(1.5 V_b), and omega_b=2π·50. Equations (4)–(5) give dδ/dt=omega_b K_p,pu (P_ref,pu−P_pu) in seconds.
scope: First-order P–f synchronization, algebraic L–R grid circuit and circular current limiter from Eqs. (4)–(6). The grid-voltage magnitude steps with no phase jump. Inner loops, filter states, PWM and hardware recovery timing remain outside the integration.
freeze_note: Source inputs were visually verified and prototyped before recording the archived run and its checks. No gain or impedance was adjusted to match the experimental outcome.
